item.title: Murmurly 2.0.1
item.description:
Double-tap works every time

A quick double-tap to lock hands-free recording could be missed: the first tap's release arrived before the microphone had come up and was dropped, so the second tap was refused, the recording quietly stopped half a second later, and people repeated themselves and got the text twice. The key is now tracked through the start, so a tap, a hold and a double-tap behave the same however fast they are. As a safeguard, the same text is never inserted twice within a couple of seconds.

Quiet by default

The sounds on start, stop and errors are off. The capsule shows the same thing. Turn them back on under Settings → General if you liked them.

Coming from Murmur 1.10

Download Murmurly from murmurly.prayasmittal.com and drag it to Applications; the updater in 1.10 can't install it. Murmurly 1.11 and later update normally.
